summary: Named as a tower in Sampson County on the TN Landforms NC list; no other source found describing the tower, its history or the site.

evidence.supports: Giddensville is listed as a lookout tower in Sampson County, with coordinates 35.14305, -78.24083
The Lovett Lee House is placed at Giddensville
The Lovett Lee House is in Sampson County

notes_for_editor: Very thin record: one list entry for a tower. Two WebSearch calls and five page reads (TopoQuest place page, Wikipedia 404, NCpedia gazetteer with no tower text, the NRHP record for the Lovett Lee House, which is used only to place the community). Searches found no tower history, build date, height, staffing or site description. The only Sampson County tower found is TopoQuest's Newkirk Lookout Tower at N34.695448 W78.264164, about 30 miles south of the list coordinates; it is not the same site and is not used, so a reader should not confuse the two. The ECU/guidebook material on NC lookouts covers the western mountains only. Status and access unknown. The story is under the 120-word floor because no further evidence exists; nothing was padded. Suggested next checks: NC Forest Service fire-tower history; the USGS Giddensville topo sheet for a tower symbol; Sampson County Library local history. The TN Landforms code column ('0 bm') is not decoded.
